  • Exports

High-level idiomatic Nim API for Pebble graphics and drawing.

This module provides wrappers for graphics context drawing operations, GBitmap management, and color handling.

Imports

../ffi

proc `==`(a, b: GColor): bool {.inline, ...raises: [], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Compare two colors for equality. Equivalent to C macro gcolor_equal(a, b).

               clip: bool = true) {.inline, ...raises: [], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Align a rectangle inside another rectangle (modifies rect in place). Equivalent to C function grect_align(&rect, &inside_rect, alignment, clip).

    tags: [], forbids: [].}
Enable or disable antialiasing (color platforms only). Equivalent to C function graphics_context_set_antialiased(ctx, enable).

Get the bounds of a GBitmap. Equivalent to C function gbitmap_get_bounds(bitmap).

Set the bounds of a GBitmap. Equivalent to C function gbitmap_set_bounds(bitmap, new_bounds). 
proc bytesPerRow(bitmap: ptr GBitmap): uint16 {.inline, ...raises: [], tags: [],
    forbids: [].}
Get the number of bytes per row in the bitmap data. Equivalent to C function gbitmap_get_bytes_per_row(bitmap). 
proc captureFrameBuffer(ctx: ptr GContext): ptr GBitmap {.inline, ...raises: [],
    tags: [], forbids: [].}
Capture the framebuffer for direct pixel access. Returns a GBitmap pointing to the framebuffer memory. Must call releaseFrameBuffer() when done. ⚠️ Advanced use only - improper use can crash the app. Equivalent to C function graphics_capture_frame_buffer(ctx). 
proc captureFrameBufferFormat(ctx: ptr GContext; format: GBitmapFormat): ptr GBitmap {.
    inline, ...raises: [], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Capture the framebuffer with a specific format. Returns a GBitmap pointing to the framebuffer memory. Must call releaseFrameBuffer() when done. ⚠️ Advanced use only - improper use can crash the app. Equivalent to C function graphics_capture_frame_buffer_format(ctx, format). 
proc centeredFromPolar(rect: GRect; scaleMode: GOvalScaleMode; angle: int32;
                       size: GSize): GRect {.inline, ...raises: [], tags: [],
    forbids: [].}
Create a rectangle centered at a polar coordinate within another rectangle. Useful for placing items in a circle or ellipse. Equivalent to C function grect_centered_from_polar(&rect, scale_mode, angle, size). 
proc centerPoint(rect: GRect): GPoint {.inline, ...raises: [], tags: [],
                                        forbids: [].}
Get the center point of a rectangle. Equivalent to C function grect_center_point(&rect). 
proc clip(rect: var GRect; clipRect: GRect) {.inline, ...raises: [], tags: [],
    forbids: [].}
Clip a rectangle to another rectangle (modifies rect in place). The resulting rectangle is the intersection of the two rectangles. Equivalent to C function grect_clip(&rect, &clip_rect). 
proc compositingMode=(ctx: ptr GContext; mode: GCompOp) {.inline, ...raises: [],
    tags: [], forbids: [].}
Set the compositing mode for bitmap blending operations. Modes: GCompOpAssign, GCompOpAssignInverted, GCompOpOr, GCompOpAnd, GCompOpClear, GCompOpSet, GCompOpAndNot, GCompOpOrNot Equivalent to C function graphics_context_set_compositing_mode(ctx, mode). 
proc containsPoint(rect: GRect; point: GPoint): bool {.inline, ...raises: [],
    tags: [], forbids: [].}
Check if a point is inside a rectangle. Equivalent to C function grect_contains_point(&rect, &point). 
proc createAsSubBitmap(baseBitmap: ptr GBitmap; subRect: GRect): ptr GBitmap {.
    inline, ...raises: [], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Create a sub-bitmap that references a portion of another bitmap. The sub-bitmap does not own the data; baseBitmap must remain valid. Equivalent to C function gbitmap_create_as_sub_bitmap(base_bitmap, sub_rect). 
proc createBlank(size: GSize; format: GBitmapFormat): ptr GBitmap {.inline,
    ...raises: [], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Create a blank bitmap with the specified size and format. Used for offscreen rendering or as a frame buffer for animations. Returns nil if allocation fails. Equivalent to C function gbitmap_create_blank(size, format). 
proc createBlankWithPalette(size: GSize; format: GBitmapFormat;
                            palette: ptr GColor; freeOnDestroy: bool): ptr GBitmap {.
    inline, ...raises: [], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Create a blank bitmap with a custom color palette. palette must remain valid for the bitmap's lifetime unless freeOnDestroy is true. Equivalent to C function gbitmap_create_blank_with_palette(size, format, palette, free_on_destroy). 
proc createWithData(data: ptr uint8): ptr GBitmap {.inline, ...raises: [],
    tags: [], forbids: [].}
Create a bitmap from existing raw pixel data. data must remain valid for the bitmap's lifetime. Equivalent to C function gbitmap_create_with_data(data). 
proc crop(rect: GRect; cropSizePx: int32): GRect {.inline, ...raises: [], tags: [],
    forbids: [].}
Return a new rectangle cropped by the specified number of pixels on each side. Equivalent to C function grect_crop(rect, crop_size_px). 
proc data(bitmap: ptr GBitmap): pointer {.inline, ...raises: [], tags: [],
    forbids: [].}
Get a pointer to the raw bitmap data. Equivalent to C function gbitmap_get_data(bitmap). 
proc destroy(bitmap: ptr GBitmap) {.inline, ...raises: [], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Destroy a GBitmap and free its memory. Equivalent to C function gbitmap_destroy(bitmap). 
proc drawArc(ctx: ptr GContext; rect: GRect; scaleMode: GOvalScaleMode;
             angleStart: int32; angleEnd: int32) {.inline, ...raises: [], tags: [],
    forbids: [].}
Draw an arc (outline) within a rectangle. angleStart and angleEnd are in Pebble angle units (0 to TRIG_MAX_ANGLE). scaleMode determines how the arc is fitted to the rectangle. Useful for circular progress indicators or gauges. Equivalent to C function graphics_draw_arc(ctx, rect, scale_mode, angle_start, angle_end).

Draw a bitmap in a box. Equivalent to C function graphics_draw_bitmap_in_rect(ctx, bitmap, box).

Draw a rotated bitmap. srcImageCenter is the center point in the source bitmap coordinates. destImageCenter is where to draw the center on the screen. Equivalent to C function graphics_draw_rotated_bitmap(...).

Draw a rounded rectangle outline. Equivalent to C function graphics_draw_round_rect(ctx, rect, radius). 
proc drawText(ctx: ptr GContext; text: cstring; font: GFont; box: GRect;
              overflow: GTextOverflowMode; alignment: GTextAlignment;
              textAttributes: ptr GTextAttributes = nil) {.inline, ...raises: [],
    tags: [], forbids: [].}

Draw text in a box with specified font, alignment, and overflow mode.

⚠️ CString Lifetime: The text cstring must remain valid for the duration of the draw operation. Use string literals or ensure the buffer is not freed before the function returns.

Equivalent to C function graphics_draw_text(...).

proc fillColor=(ctx: ptr GContext; color: GColor8) {.inline, ...raises: [],

Set the fill color for drawing operations. Equivalent to C function graphics_context_set_fill_color(ctx, color). 
proc fillRadial(ctx: ptr GContext; rect: GRect; scaleMode: GOvalScaleMode;
                insetThick: uint16; angleStart: int32; angleEnd: int32) {.
    inline, ...raises: [], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Fill a radial section (pie slice) within a rectangle. angleStart and angleEnd are in Pebble angle units (0 to TRIG_MAX_ANGLE). scaleMode determines how the arc is fitted to the rectangle. insetThick creates a hollow effect (0 for filled, >0 for ring thickness). Useful for pie charts, circular progress, or gauge fills. Equivalent to C function graphics_fill_radial(ctx, rect, scale_mode, inset_thickness, angle_start, angle_end). 
proc fillRect(ctx: ptr GContext; rect: GRect) {.inline, ...raises: [], tags: [],
    forbids: [].}
Fill a rectangle. Equivalent to C function graphics_fill_rect(ctx, rect, 0, GCornerNone).

    forbids: [].}
Fill a rectangle with rounded corners. Equivalent to C function graphics_fill_rect(ctx, rect, radius, corners).

    forbids: [].}
Get the pixel format of the bitmap. Equivalent to C function gbitmap_get_format(bitmap). 
proc fromPolar(rect: GRect; scaleMode: GOvalScaleMode; angle: int32): GPoint {.
    inline, ...raises: [], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Calculate a point from polar coordinates within a rectangle. The point is on an ellipse fitted to the rectangle. Angle is in Pebble angle units (0 to TRIG_MAX_ANGLE). scaleMode determines how the ellipse is fitted to the rectangle. Equivalent to C function gpoint_from_polar(&rect, scale_mode, angle). 
proc inset(rect: GRect; insets: GEdgeInsets): GRect {.inline, ...raises: [],

Returns a GRect inset by the given edge insets. Equivalent to C function grect_inset(rect, insets). 
proc isFrameBufferCaptured(ctx: ptr GContext): bool {.inline, ...raises: [],
    tags: [], forbids: [].}
Check if the framebuffer is currently captured. Useful for verifying state before drawing operations. Equivalent to C function graphics_frame_buffer_is_captured(ctx). 
proc legibleOver(color: GColor): GColor {.inline, ...raises: [], tags: [],

Get a legible text color (black or white) for the given background color. Returns GColorBlack or GColorWhite depending on background luminance. Equivalent to C function gcolor_legible_over(color).

Create a GBitmap from a resource ID. The caller is responsible for calling destroy() when done. Equivalent to C function gbitmap_create_with_resource(resource_id).

proc palette(bitmap: ptr GBitmap): ptr GColor {.inline, ...raises: [], tags: [],

Get the color palette for palette-based bitmaps. Equivalent to C function gbitmap_get_palette(bitmap). 
proc releaseFrameBuffer(ctx: ptr GContext; bitmap: ptr GBitmap): bool {.inline,
    ...raises: [], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Release the captured framebuffer. Must be called after captureFrameBuffer() to prevent display corruption. Returns true on success. ⚠️ Advanced use only. Equivalent to C function graphics_release_frame_buffer(ctx, bitmap).

Standardize a rectangle in place (ensures size.w and size.h are non-negative). Equivalent to C function grect_standardize(&rect).
